result:
Done. Created `operations/engineering/fars/agentic/tools/finance-report.js` (196 lines, CommonJS, no deps).

**What it does:**
- Reads `events.jsonl` for transactions with `sourceAccount`/`destinationAccount`/`quantity` fields
- Computes running balances per account per commodity
- Groups accounts by type (assets, budget, active, library, operations, income, expenses, liabilities, waste, equity)
- Shows top expense accounts and budget utilization percentages
- `--period today|week|month` filters by time window
- `--format text|json` for human or machine output
- `--commodity <name>` filters by commodity
- Color-coded: waste in red, growing liabilities in yellow

Tested against live data — 11 transactions render correctly in both text and JSON modes. Task updated to `in-progress` with remaining command wiring items tracked.
